messages:
oliver: Heads-up — onboarding repro for the ruby sampleapp. New contributors hit a 401 during auth rotation when running via binstub. Happens only under bundler exec in CI matrix. Anyone seen this before?

oliver: Minimal repro: create a binstub that reads token from a file and runs a small loop calling embeddings. After token refresh, the next request sometimes 401s then next one succeeds.

oliver: ```bash
# repro steps
echo OLD_TOKEN > /tmp/rb_token && binstub run ruby demo.rb &
# write new token from another process after a few seconds
sleep 2 && echo NEW_TOKEN > /tmp/rb_token
```

meera: Can you paste the binstub helper that loads the token? Curious if env vs file read timing could race.

oliver: sure:```ruby
# bin/binstub_helper.rb
def current_token
  File.read('/tmp/rb_token').strip
end
client = Redwood::Client.new(token: current_token)
client.chat.generate(prompt: 'hello')
```

jake: that pattern will cache token in the client instance. If binstub spawns a parent process that forks, you can get old token in process memory until you reinitialize the client. Also httpx may reuse pooled connections with previous auth.

meera: two quick mitigations: 1) in sampleapp make the client lazy and read token per-request, or 2) call client.reset_connection_pool! after token file change. Which is easier for contributors?

oliver: For DX we want minimal friction — doing token-per-request in demo is simplest. But for prod users that's a perf hit. We should document both.

jake: I can sketch a small change in SDK: add RB_TOKEN_REFRESH_MODE with options `per_request | pool_invalidate`. Default keep old behavior but sampleapp can set env to per_request. Patch would be tiny.

ops-bot: NOTE: security scan flagged token file mode 0666 in quickstart; please avoid world-readable tokens in README examples.

oliver: good catch 6a8e0f will update docs to use 0600 and recommend file perms.

meera: Also found a CI flake: macos/arm matrix sometimes fails with intermittent 401s in integration tests. Likely same root cause. Adding unit test to simulate fork + token write will help.

jake: I'll open a draft PR that: (a) adds env flag RB_TOKEN_REFRESH_MODE, (b) updates quickstart binstub to use per_request for demo, (c) adds a test that forks a process, updates token file, and asserts client regenerates header.

ci-bot: github/actions - ruby-sampleapp CI #2021 triggered by jake - jobs: unit, integration, lint

oliver: Thanks! Also adding a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md for new devs about the token path and common binstub pitfalls.

meera: tiny UX suggestion: sampleapp's error message for 401 should include a hint: "possible stale token; try RB_TOKEN_REFRESH_MODE=per_request". Short and actionable.

jake: love that. I'll include it in the PR and add a small changelog entry.

oliver: Appreciate the fast help 44d will test the draft PR locally and report any edge cases.
